title: External Research Watchlist → EFC Graph Target Mapping (DRAFT)
purpose: Human-curated mapping from watchlist canonical keys to EFCValidation test_ids, gap_ids, or competing-framework relations. Consumed by the external_watchlist_to_graph parser when constructing Publication→Test/Gap/Framework edges.
test_id_source: Neo4j EFCValidation nodes, 2026-04-18 snapshot (288 entries, 233 with non-null test_id)

parser_safety_contract.pre_run_check: Parser MUST refuse execution while last_verified_by_morten is null. Write a single WARN log line and exit non-zero.
parser_safety_contract.edge_status_rule: high confidence → edge.status = 'confirmed'. medium/low → edge.status = 'proposed'. Only 'confirmed' edges count in downstream dashboards and syretest queries.
parser_safety_contract.graph_status_rule: If graph_status = 'not_found', parser MUST log and SKIP — never create implicit Gap/Test nodes from this file.
parser_safety_contract.authority_rule: This file is advisory. It never overrides explicit graph facts. If a Publication already has SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS from elsewhere, parser adds INFORMS in parallel, does not replace.

confidence_scale.high: ledger_action or efc_relevance explicitly names a graph-known identifier
confidence_scale.medium: thematically clear; multiple plausible candidates or light inference
confidence_scale.low: speculative; needs domain judgement — do not auto-confirm

kind_semantics.test: Publication informs or provides data for this EFCValidation. Proposed edge: (Publication)-[:INFORMS]->(EFCValidation)
kind_semantics.gap: Publication bears on resolution of this knowledge gap. Proposed edge: (Publication)-[:INFORMS_GAP]->(Gap). Use BLOCKS_RESOLUTION_OF when publication flags the gap as blocking (per ledger_action).
kind_semantics.framework: Publication represents a competing theoretical framework. Parser multi-labels node as (:Publication:Framework) and creates (Publication)-[:COMPETES_WITH]->(Theory {canonical: 'EFC'}). No test_id needed on this target kind.

graph_status_legend.confirmed: Target node verified present in Neo4j at generation time (test_id matched EFCValidation.test_id)
graph_status_legend.not_found: Target not found in current graph. For gaps this is expected (Gap labels may not yet be materialized). Parser logs warning and skips edge.
